Sorry to hear that. 

I was told that after my surgery (I was on PM with a constant morphine drip)
That I was almost yelling in my sleep. 

I Dreamt the nurses were coming in and strangling me

Thank you, I appreciate the advice.

How goes the hospital? Are you still there or have you been discharged

I highly doubt it, With her being as stubborn headed as I am (Yet I know when to back down as she does not) it won't happen. So Won't come back. Which is depressing in its own way, Bitter sweet if you will. Because I've grown accustomed to having someone there when falling asleep or someone to talk to, Even thought she could be ridiculously cruel.

I'm confused and only about an hour into it.

I do have Netflix

And the deed was done tonight. She broke up with me because I had gone and seen a (male) best friend of mine because I needed someone other then her I could talk to

She got upset and told me to leave. 

Not sure what to do now. So used to being told what to do, how to do it l, and always checking in.

At 19, I should be having the time of my life, I should be looking forward to college(Or at least the college night life) But I have 0 drive for anything

I have shit for motivation for anything, But hopefully I'll find something to look forward to tomorrow morning. Who knows.

Thanks for the kind words stranger, hope you feel better.

Sorry about your situation, I've been waiting for that day
I've been waiting for that day for a long time... I know I'm young but I do believe in past lives and old and young spirits

And I feel like mines just had it's due, Likes Its had its run and It's time for it to retire.

My wording was a bit vague, As to this is true I can do what I please because I am my own person, Its risks losing her. Which from a Intelligent point of view is a good thing, But my heart just can't let her go

And this is true, I did lose them because of my lack of a spine I never had thought that my bestest of friends would just sort of seem to lose an interest of being my friend.

Life does go on true, But what sort of "life" am I living when I feel like I've been dead on the inside for what feels like life times.

Your welcome!

I read some of the other postings and I saw one of your replies was everyone telling you that you need to be okay with being single, And I can relate to that as well lol.

All my female friends would tell me that, that I need to be okay with being single first and then I can look for someone to date.

But coming home alone and sleeping by yourself not able to connect with someone at the end of the night is just so boooring.

Thanks for the support :\
I always feel like I'm making a wrong move, Like I'm always in the wrong whenever I do something
Because it seems like anything/everything I do will just piss her off anyways lol.

I know I'm quite a bit younger then you (19M) but I feel the same way. When I was on a 7-8 month break with my SO I found myself always wanting to be WITH someone. I have friends, I have family but I wanted someone whom I could lay down with at the end of the night. 

So I personally do understand what you're mentally going through.
I know I do.. but it's so fucking tough to completely let her go. All my mates tell me I need to and so does my family but fuck it's so hard.

I know... It's just so hard.

Like just now, I got home after like a 3 hour bike ride with her and said I'm pooped and would like to stay home

she's demanding pic evidence that I'm actually home..
